1.31.0.note: 2026-11-19: main's OCR-first S-visible work (owner decision 2026-11-18): the visible page judges, so a PDF page with an invisible text layer has no text layer, for every document type. 1.32.0.note: 2026-11-21: OCR-11 (owner decision 2026-11-21): a read that found nothing on the page is a failed read. The approval read whose page IMAGE is (nearly) all white (income_declaration.approval_page_white: under 0.2% ink pixels) fails with no paid call, one sweep retry, then the officer's; a genuine unmarked document stays a checked, unapproved read. The student verdict no longer counts a reader's bookkeeping fields, or a list or dict with nothing filled inside, as read (vision/judge._any_field_filled); an all-empty AI answer on the results slip or higher results is a failed read (vision/field_extraction._empty_answer_failed). Review round 1: those three definitions and read_errors.EMPTY_ANSWER are now pins of this model, so the digest moved from 1.31.0's.

1.33.0.note: 2026-11-21: OCR-11 review round 2. The white check judges no image over 16 MP (income_declaration.WHITE_CHECK_MAX_PIXELS, read from the header; a JPEG after its reduced-scale draft) and no 16/32-bit or float image (modes I, I;16, F): both are not white, so the approval read goes ahead as before 1.32.0. The pins are now the callers (income_declaration.read_approval, vision/field_extraction._read_higher_results), whose closures hold the checks, so deleting the white check, the one-retry window close or the higher-results empty check moves the digest.
